client_ids.description: Specifies the list of client IDs registered in the OIDC identity provider. A maximum of 100 client IDs can be configured, and each client ID contains 1 to 255 characters.

created_at.description: The creation time of the OIDC identity provider.

description.description: Specifies the description of the OIDC identity provider. The description contains a maximum of 255 characters and cannot contain the following characters: @, #, %, &, <, >, ", $, ^ and *.

name.description: Specifies the name of the OIDC identity provider. The name contains 1 to 64 characters and can only contain letters, digits, underscores (_) and hyphens (-).

thumbprints.description: Specifies the list of server certificate fingerprints of the OIDC identity provider. If this parameter is not specified, IAM automatically obtains the CA certificate fingerprint of the JWKS endpoint.

url.description: Specifies the URL of the OIDC identity provider. The value corresponds to the issuer field in the OpenID Connect metadata document of the identity provider, and contains 1 to 255 characters.

urn.description: The uniform resource name of the OIDC identity provider.
